name: day_octopus_punch
description: Day octopus (same animal and footprint as day_octopus) throwing a side-on punch: one front arm shot nearly straight out to the right like a jab from under the head, ending in a tight curled tip at about (+520,-150), with three white motion lines behind it; the other arms stay planted on the sand. Still an arm (no fingers). Anchor bottom-centre (sand line); ~x -350..+560, y -405..0.
